name: Kessler
occupation: Fremont County commissioner-elect, District 4, taking office in January 2027 (official 2026 general results)
background: Steff Kessler is the Fremont County commissioner-elect for District 4 and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Michael Jones, who did not seek re-election and is serving through the current term. County 10 reported that she led a five-candidate Republican primary field on August 18, 2026, and she was unopposed in the November general election. No separate public-record account of her private occupation or education was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
